title: Dangote Cement pauses plan to pursue UK listing
summary: Dangote Cement pauses plan to pursue UK listing
body_markdown:
**Nigeria:** Dangote Cement postponed its plans for a secondary listing in London on 10 November 2026, citing deteriorating market conditions. In an update to the Nigerian Stock Exchange, Dangote Cement said it was no longer pursuing a UK listing “at this time,” blaming the decision on “current market conditions and the company's strategic priorities.”


Dangote Cement, which listed on the Nigerian stock market in 2010, said in May 2026 that it ​was in early talks over a potential US$18bn London listing, a move that would have widened its access to overseas investors and capital.
